projects.name: cJSON
projects.lead: simdjson VLDB 2019 paper (arXiv 1902.08318) Table 10 has cJSON throughput on 14 files next to RapidJSON, nlohmann/json and jsmn; the jsmn enricher reported cJSON beats jsmn on 11 of 14 files. nativejson-benchmark also has a cJSON row. Report the comparison honestly, including where RapidJSON wins.
